sources.label: New mask, same task.
sources.author: Doom
patch_list: Disables PicsArt banner and interstitial ads by forcing the central AdsManager gate to ads-off.
Removes the PicsArt watermark from exported photos and videos.
Unlocks PicsArt premium locally: forces the subscription state to subscribed at the data-class root so tools/effects unlock and upgrade prompts are skipped.

patch_list: Stops Picsart from killing the process after a few seconds when the APK is re-signed.
Removes the "Try PRO" pill from the home toolbar and the create tab.
